Continue beyond Module 111 with these extra modules:

- [Extra Module 00: Structural Verilog Coding](extra00-structural.qmd): Refactor a monolithic design into separate register blocks, using an eight-sample statistics circuit.
- [Extra Module 01: Advanced Verilog Syntax](extra01-advanced-syntax.qmd): Build reusable designs with parameters, arrays, loops, generate blocks, and conditional compilation.
- [Extra Module 10: SystemVerilog Constructs](extra10-systemverilog-constructs.qmd): Rewrite familiar Verilog using `logic`, packed array ports, `always_ff`/`always_comb`, enums, and structs.
